_notice: DENTRACE Clinical Anomaly & Tooth Mapping Specification. Strictly distinguishes true instance segmentation masks from bounding-box detection fallbacks.

target_pathologies.clinical_notes: Enamel/dentin demineralization. In OPGs, proximal and deep dentin caries are distinguishable; early occlusal lesions frequently require bitewing confirmation.
Circumscribed apical bone resorption associated with necrotic pulp or chronic apical periodontitis. Mandates periapical radiograph confirmation.
Horizontal or vertical reduction in alveolar bone crest height relative to cementoenamel junction (CEJ). Often annotated as polyline/box; must not be falsified as closed organ mask.
Tooth prevented from physiological eruption into functional occlusion. Bounding box or full tooth contour.
Radiopaque endodontic obturation material. Evaluated for obturation length, taper, and concomitant apical pathology.
Compound clinical rule condition: Coexistence of root canal obturation and active periapical radiolucency on the same tooth. Requires clinician review and intraoral periapical film.
